ai_summary: Kotyark Industries Limited's Board meeting approved routine governance matters, including the appointment of M/s. Talati & Talati LLP as new statutory auditors and M/s. Mittal V. Kothari & Associates as secretarial auditors, alongside setting the 10th Annual General Meeting for August 22, 2026. The Board also fixed a final dividend of Rs. 5.00 per equity share for the FY26, with a record date of August 14, 2026. A significant red flag exists in the dividend announcement, where the accompanying note states the "aggregate dividend payout remains substantially unchanged" after a 10:1 bonus issue, which directly contradicts a Rs. 5.00 per share payout on a much larger post-bonus capital and creates material ambiguity regarding effective shareholder returns.
